title: Formation of structural attractors in neuromorphic systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.06826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper examines the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which proposes a non-optimization approach to concept formation. Learning is interpreted as convergence to structural attractors in a hypergraph space, rather than as the minimization of a global loss function. The paper presents the ISL model, including its mathematical formalization, computational verification, and a hypothetical neurobiological interpretation. The mathematical section introduces the formal apparatus of the structural reduction process and proves its finite convergence, the existence and uniqueness of class structural attractors, and the self-organization of attractor maps. translated_title: 神经形态系统中结构吸引子的形成
translated_abstract: 本文研究了不变结构学习（ISL）理论，该理论提出了一种非优化的概念形成方法。学习被解释为在超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛过程，而非对全局损失函数的最小化。论文提出了ISL模型，包括其数学形式化、计算验证以及假设性的神经生物学解释。数学部分介绍了结构化简过程的形式化工具，并证明了其有限收敛性、类结构吸引子的存在性与唯一性，以及吸引子图的自组织性。计算部分通过经典图像识别任务验证了该方法的可行性，利用所提出的学习机制实现了无需反向传播且训练数据集极小的学习。最后，神经生物学部分提出了相应的生物学假说。
tldr: 本文提出不变结构学习（ISL）理论，将学习视为超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛而非损失函数最小化，实现了无需反向传播、仅需极小训练数据集的图像识别学习机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which interprets learning as convergence to structural attractors in hypergraph space rather than loss function minimization, achieving image recognition without backpropagation using extremely small training datasets.
